title: 行車控制中心人機介面
summary: 本課聚焦行控資訊層次警報與人員判讀。從警報負荷與重複建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把畫面位置資料年齡與顯示可讀性環境連成可驗證的介面，最後以少量受試結果外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies control-centre information hierarchy alarms and human interpretation. Start with alarm loading and duplication to define physical or information boundaries, connect age of displayed position data with viewing environment and legibility as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating limited user trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究警報負荷與重複。原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。敏感度只改 events=18 至 19 alarms，輸出變為 3.16667 alarms/min；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究察覺與動作延遲：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate alarm loading and duplication. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. For sensitivity, change only events=18 to 19 alarms; the output becomes 3.16667 alarms/min. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate detection and action delay: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 警報負荷與重複與察覺與動作延遲
stages.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication & Detection and action delay
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警報負荷與重複」與「察覺與動作延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alarm loading and duplication" and "Detection and action delay": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警報負荷與重複」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alarm loading and duplication” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。大量同根因警報可能淹沒最早的關鍵訊息；抑制重複訊號應保留可追溯性，不能以刪掉重要警報來美化數字。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警報負荷與重複」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability. Many alarms from one cause can obscure the first critical message. Duplicate suppression must preserve traceability rather than deleting important alarms to improve a metric. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alarm loading and duplication” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警報負荷與重複」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alarm loading and duplication”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「警報負荷與重複」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「警報負荷與重複」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alarm loading and duplication” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「警報負荷與重複」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alarm loading and duplication” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「警報負荷與重複」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. For alarm loading and duplication, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把警報數 events 從 18 改成 19 alarms（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變為 3.16667 alarms/min。先說明「警報負荷與重複」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only alarm count events from 18 to 19 alarms (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3 to 3.16667 alarms/min. Explain the causal direction for alarm loading and duplication, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警報負荷與重複」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alarm loading and duplication” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。回到「警報負荷與重複」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. Trace the input chain for alarm loading and duplication. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「事件時間線一致性」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consistency of event timelines” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元對照各設備日誌的時鐘偏移，防止畫面上的先後排序讓操作員建立錯誤因果故事。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「事件時間線一致性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare clock offsets in equipment logs so display ordering does not lead operators to construct an incorrect causal explanation. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consistency of event timelines” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「事件時間線一致性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Consistency of event timelines”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Consistency of event timelines" is correct?

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「事件時間線一致性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Consistency of event timelines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「事件時間線一致性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Consistency of event timelines", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合

optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「事件時間線一致性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Consistency of event timelines” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「事件時間線一致性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For consistency of event timelines, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「事件時間線一致性」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for consistency of event timelines, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「事件時間線一致性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Consistency of event timelines"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

quiz.explanationEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 事件時間線一致性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Consistency of event timelines: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件時間線一致性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Consistency of event timelines” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「事件時間線一致性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for consistency of event timelines. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.explanationEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 畫面位置資料年齡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Age of displayed position data: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「畫面位置資料年齡」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Age of displayed position data” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元讓位置圖示同時顯示資料年齡，辨認流暢動畫與可信即時資訊並不是同一件事。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「畫面位置資料年齡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Display data age alongside the position symbol, distinguishing a smooth animation from trustworthy current information. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Age of displayed position data” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
